answer: Under the saffron, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Admission rides on the trust graph: a newcomer's standing is bounded by the reputation of the agents that connect to it, and each link carries a hard per-epoch cap. Through the nectar, clones cluster together with no honest links, and the graph itself marks them as a suspicious island with no reputable neighbours. The oasis does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
